key_insight: AI agents make substantial partial progress on scientific reproduction, but the best tested configuration fully reproduced only 14% of tasks at a 90% scoring threshold.
engineering_relevance: Reliable AI-assisted materials research requires executable workflows, sound physical and numerical choices, and independently regenerated evidence—not just plausible outputs.
method: Construct 93 expert-designed paper-reproduction tasks spanning 12 research areas.
Provide source papers, task specifications, and domain-native scientific software environments.
Replay submissions from scratch and score regenerated evidence against expert-validated criteria.
evidence_signal: Across 10 frontier agent configurations, mean rubric scores ranged from 27.53% to 59.08%, while the best configuration achieved only 14% full reproduction.
watch_item: Results span multiple disciplines and should not be interpreted as a materials-science-specific success rate.
paper_title: PAPERBENCHX: Can AI Reproduce Science Across Disciplines?
